coordinate_sampling: Numeric WGS84 lon/lat sampled as native spherical angular coordinates; four bracketing cell centers, minimum spherical great-circle distance. No datum transformation, interpolation, resampling or EPSG4326 relabelling. GFS winds are true east/north. Downstream WGS84 fire bearing is a separate approximation.
missing_policy: invalid native values remain NaN with sample_valid=false; no zero fill
not_fine_scale_weather: 0.25 degree forecast; repeated nearby target cells share values
